finalText:
Fixed it. Two real bugs from the bump, both in the link stage, everything else was noise.

1. `src/core/options.js` still read `options.retries`, but the new bundler passes `retryCount`. That was crashing the build outright.
2. `src/net/retryPolicy.js` treated a missing backoff flag as an error instead of "off." The new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` rather than `false`, so it now just defaults to disabled.

Build finishes clean now, 0 errors, still 8 harmless deprecation warnings.
